title: Kerala lottery Bhagyathara BT-68 result today 24/08/2026: ₹1 cr first prize for BW 585405 | Check complete list
content: The Kerala State Lottery Department has announced the results of the Bhagyathara BT-68 lottery draw. The lucky draw was held at Gorky Bhavan, near Bakery Junction in Thiruvananthapuram, at 3 pm on Monday. The first prize is 1 crore, subject to a 30% tax deduction. The second prize is 30 lakh, followed by a third prize of 5 lakh. Check complete results here: First prize: 1 cr – BW 585405 (Cons prize: 5,000 for all the remaining series) Second prize: 30 lakh – BW 364280 Third prize: 5 lakh - BZ 567138 Fourth prize: 5,000 (19) 1247, 1762, 1779, 2227, 2696, 2721, 3180, 3743, 3964, 4598, 5778, 5928, 6655, 7141, 8363, 8907, 9131, 9252, 9851 Fifth prize: 2,000 (6) 2767, 4131, 5573, 7816, 9298, 9801 Sixth prize: 1,000 (25) 0324, 1125, 1354, 1598, 1843, 2137, 2232, 2610, 2720, 2805, 3418, 4283, 4828, 5267, 5443, 6079, 6811, 6850, 7646, 8240, 8291, 8802, 9120, 9235, 9772 Kerala lottery result yesterday: Samrudhi SM-69 result today 23/08/2026 Winners in the Kerala state lottery must verify their ticket numbers against the results published in the official Kerala Government Gazette. According to the Kerala State Lotteries Department, prize claims must be submitted within 30 days of the draw date. Winners of the first and second prizes are required to surrender their tickets either in person or via insured registered post to the Director of State Lotteries. Alternatively, claims can be submitted through nationalised, scheduled, state, or district co-operative banks, along with the necessary documents. Claimants must also provide valid identification, such as an Aadhaar or PAN card, when submitting their winning ticket.
